title: Admin control-plane zero-trust review and pen-test remediation for RBAC/audit/SSO
creator: Asha Rao
description: Summary: This ticket coordinates remediation of pen-test and internal security review findings that affect the admin control plane. Scope spans RBAC v2 policy evaluation, SAML/SSO assertion validation hardening, and audit logging integrity for admin actions. Goals: eliminate privilege escalation paths identified in the pen-test, ensure tamper-evident admin audit trails, and adopt least-privilege defaults for newly introduced RBAC v2 role derivation rules.
acceptance_criteria: All pen-test findings categorized as high or critical are either remediated or have a documented compensating control and mitigation plan
RBAC v2 role derivation and promotion flows have explicit policy checks preventing implicit escalation (unit + integration tests added)
SAML assertion validation rejects unsigned RelayState and prevents assertion replay (replay tests pass)
Audit pipeline persists admin action events to immutable store and has alerts for audit forwarder failures
Post-remediation verification performed by security team and low/medium residual items tracked separately
implementation_steps: Consolidate pen-test findings into discrete remediation tasks and map to owners (security + platform) - done
Design policy gates for RBAC v2: deny-by-default, explicit grant for privileged transitions - PR spec in Confluence
Add server-side enforcement for SAML audiences, assertion lifetime, and signature verification across admin endpoints
Upgrade audit forwarder to write a cryptographic hash chain per admin-session and store daily snapshots to customer-audit-bucket
Instrument telemetry: number of policy denials, SAML validation failures, audit-forwarder error rate; add Datadog dashboards and alerts
Develop regression tests: simulated delegated token path, SAML assertion replay, audit-forwarder outage and recovery
Code changes -> internal review -> security review -> staged rollout -> runbook update -> pen-test retest
notes: Pen-test report (2026-01) called out two main classes of issues: (1) insufficient checks on delegated role elevation paths; (2) audit-forwarder outages leading to gaps in admin trails
RBAC v2 introduced role-derivation rules to simplify admin UX; some legacy code paths still perform implicit promotion — must be removed
SAML integration previously accepted multiple RelayState formats; attacker demonstrated session fixation via crafted RelayState during pen test
Priority is to prevent real-world privilege escalation and to ensure forensic capability for post-incident investigations

remediation_plan: Immediate hotfix: disallow implicit role promotion code paths (remove legacy helper functions) - target deploy 2026-03-03
Medium term: introduce signed admin approval flow (HSM-backed signatures) for sensitive promotions - Q2 initiative
Audit pipeline: add immutability guarantees and periodic snapshot verification; retention policy update to 13 months
SAML: enforce strict audience + issuer checks, require signed RelayState for admin endpoints, rotate SP metadata and publish verification tests
Operational: runbook for audit-forwarder failure, playbook for restoring missing events and forensics
testing_plan: Unit tests for RBAC policy evaluator: add negative tests for all former implicit promotions
Integration test: simulate delegated token exchange and ensure policy denies unauthorized promotions
SAML fuzz tests: replay scenarios, RelayState manipulation, expired assertion flows
Chaos test: kill audit-forwarder process during high admin activity and validate snapshot/repair flow
Pen-test retest and final sign-off by Security (evidence bundle uploaded to drive)
